labels.notes: AUDIT-1 major resolved. The module docstring writes the label without the ** mark, followed by « NOT marked (« le conjugué » depends on OQ-163, see SCOPE) ». The REPORT row is status partial, marked false, and its question names OQ-163 with the (a)/(b)/(c) consequences. The checklist row « complémentaire le conjugué » reads « ⚠ read (OQ-163) ». SCOPE says the row is NOT marked until OQ-163 is ruled. Under (b) or (c) it closes with no Lean change. Under (a) the statement of record uses « the conjugate meeting L only at 0 » (conjugue_eq_of_disjoint) or « the least distinguished conjugate » (conjugue_le_of_sontConjugues), and demiDroite_complement_conjugue is the witness that not every (a)-conjugate is the complement. OQ-163 is still OPEN in registers/DECISIONS.md:391, so unmarked/partial is the correct state. No Lean statement changed: theoreme2 (l.277–286) is exactly AUDIT-1's description (Convex, 0 ∈ W, span = ⊤, ¬ContientDroite; ∃ B : BooleanAlgebra (Distingues W) with le = inclusion, ⊤, ⊥, compl = conjugue W, ⊓, ⊔), and demiDroite_complement_conjugue (l.680) is unchanged in content.
